scope: Posthoc deterministic classification of existing normal baseline outputs only; no new model execution, fitting, recipe selection or candidate advancement.

definitions.exact_answer: First standalone six-digit number equals the queried answer.
definitions.wrong_existing_record_value: First number is another value explicitly present among parsed prompt records.
definitions.echoed_queried_key: First number equals the queried key.
definitions.other_six_digit: A standalone six-digit number exists but matches none of the above.
definitions.no_six_digit: No standalone six-digit number exists within the recorded max12-token output.

limitations: Wrong existing value is a surface-output association category, not proof of which internal retrieval/state/decoding mechanism failed.
Other six-digit output can involve numeric decoding/composition errors; it is not a missing-format error.
The fixed first-match scorer and max12-token generation are retained; later digits or alternative matching are not rescored.
These are already-observed development prompts, not unseen confirmation. No adapter outcomes or training trajectory are examined.
